integrity: Same-model scientific review of complete proof, finite algorithms, mathematical scope and source-implication comparisons; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Full multipartite VC dimension is proved for feasible palettes q>=r; exact Littlestone dimensions are asserted only for K_(2,2,2). An exhaustive computation proves its four-color adaptive exclusion, while a checked tree proves its five-color lower bound. Priority is conditional on inspected literature and lacks independent validation.
title: Palette capacity and an adaptive phase in complete multipartite colouring concepts
